lines.en: You know, I don't know why you're so embarrassed.
I wouldn't want to be there when the laughter stops.
Whoa, whoa, back up there, Sparky.
What did you mean by that?
Well, it just seems as though that maybe you have intimacy issues.
You know, that you use your humor as a way of keeping people at a distance.
I mean, hey, I just met you.
I don't know you from Adam.
Parents divorced before you hit puberty.
Hey, how long are you in the city?
Just for a couple of days.
I figure I'm better off staying with the kid than hauling my ass back and forth down the ferry.
Oh, this is my friend, Roger.
Hey, good to meet you, Roger.
What happened to the puppet guy?
